method: Smoothed categorical: Bayesian shrinkage target encoding for 4 cat features, cross-fit 5-fold. LGBM on 21raw+4smooth vs 21raw.

correction_20261018_d.defect_1_protocol: build_smoothed_features() cross-fit encodings for every row k over folds != k. Consequently the outer-FIT rows (folds 1-4, used as LGBM training rows for the fold-0 screen) received encodings whose statistics were computed from folds {0,2,3,4}, {0,1,3,4}, ... i.e. INCLUDING the outer evaluation fold's (fold-0) satisfaction labels. The evaluation fold's labels leaked into the training features -> contaminated fold-0 evaluation.
correction_20261018_d.defect_2_provenance: prereg_sha256 was 'TODO'; corrected here to the verified value.
correction_20261018_d.defect_3_decision_rule: Report applied augmentation_delta >= +5e-5 (raw 21-model delta) instead of the frozen prereg rule: operational port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
correction_20261018_d.superseded_by: configs/phase20/feat54_strict_prereg.json (strict outer-FIT-only, inner-cross-fitted re-measurement, not yet run at time of this note)
